name: prone bench flutter kicks
description: Alternating small leg lifts while lying face down on a bench. The glutes and the backs of the thighs do most of the work.
instructions: Lie face down on a sturdy bench with your hips supported and your legs extending beyond the end.
Hold the bench for stability and keep your trunk steady.
Lift one straight leg slightly as the other lowers, then alternate in small controlled kicks.
Avoid arching your lower back or swinging the legs high.
